<title level="1" right="Rules">[Attribute Modifiers](/Rules.aspx?ID=3240)</title>

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 304

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Intelligent items have Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers, though as inanimate objects, they don’t have Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution entries.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
